**Dispatch order** — `domain:ui` seat, PM session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q`. Branch: `claude/issue-6317-gallery-select-options`.

### Triage's ruling, verbatim

> Triage: promoted `finding` → `pm:queue` (keeping `domain:ui`, lands in `apps/site/app/components/galleryDataSource.ts` and its catalog-test mirror), type **Task**. Fix as suggested: declare `options` on both fields with labels matching the values already in `USERS_ROWS`, keep the fixture and mirror in step, and take the before/after on the `plugin-grid` / `plugin-view` tiles deliberately (select cells will start rendering labels instead of raw values — that is the intended behaviour of the component the docs exist to show, so the text change is an improvement to accept, not a regression to avoid). Afterwards the #6167 entries can stop steering around `role`/`status`. Size/model suggestion: S, sonnet.

### The values, measured rather than assumed

Read on `origin/main` at `831be7285`. `role` is declared at `galleryDataSource.ts:76` and `status` at `:86`; the five `USERS_ROWS` (lines 100–104) carry exactly:

- `role`: `admin`, `member`, `viewer` — 3 distinct
- `status`: `active`, `invited`, `suspended` — 3 distinct

Re-derive these yourself from the rows rather than trusting this list, and derive them **structurally** (walk the rows) rather than by a shaped grep. Two demo-shaped censuses on a recent card in this lane each undercounted a fixture because they were grepped rather than walked, and a count that is wrong in a plausible direction is worse than one that is obviously wrong. If your walk disagrees with the three-and-three above, your walk wins — say so in the report.

### The tile text change is expected — do not treat it as a regression

Once `options` are declared, select cells render **labels instead of raw values**, so the `plugin-grid` / `plugin-view` gallery tiles will change text. Triage has already ruled that deliberate: it is the intended behaviour of the very component these docs exist to demonstrate. Take the before/after consciously and show it in the report. ⛔ Do not add a workaround to keep the old raw-value text, and do not narrow the labels to equal the values just to keep a snapshot green — that would reintroduce the defect while appearing to fix it.

### Keep the mirror in step

The fixture and its catalog-test mirror must move together. A mirror left behind is the failure mode this card is a member of: two declarations of the same fixture disagreeing. If you find the mirror already disagrees with the fixture in some *other* way, file that, do not fold it.

### File face

`apps/site/app/components/galleryDataSource.ts` and its catalog-test mirror, plus any pin you add. Nothing else.

**The `#6167` follow-on is out of scope.** Triage notes that afterwards those entries can stop steering around `role`/`status` — that is a consequence to record, not work to do here. File it; do not fold it in.

### In-flight, do not touch

#6515 · #6519 · #6329 · #6343 — all in `packages/app-shell`, measured disjoint from your face in `apps/site`.

Reverse verification is required: write the assertion first, observe it fail against the untouched fixture, and prove the mutation on disk by counting the changed text rather than trusting an editor's exit code.
